summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Menu category-chip cleanup (no Tous, no stale burgers, default Signatures active) and (2) global ScrollToTop route listener. Every acceptance criterion from the review request passed. Menu shows exactly 9 category chips (signatures, classiques, smash-burgers, wraps, sandwiches, sides, kids, desserts, drinks). Signatures is active on first render and renders 8 items. Kids chip renders Menu Kids. ScrollToTop resets window.scrollY to 0 on: Home→/menu, /menu→/cart, /cart→/checkout, /admin/orders→/admin/settings, /admin/orders→/admin/stats/delivery.
critical_code_review_comments: The review request referenced the header cart testid as 'header-cart' but the actual attribute in Header.jsx is data-testid='cart-icon-link'. Not a bug — just a documentation discrepancy for future testers. Consider aligning testid names with the request's naming convention, or update docs.

In Menu.jsx, the Wraps category currently renders 6 items in the preview DB, not the 3 mentioned in the review request. Functionality (category switching) works correctly — this is a data content discrepancy, not a code bug.

ScrollToTop uses behavior: 'instant' which is a non-standard value; Chromium accepts it (treats as auto/immediate) but Firefox may fall back to 'auto'. Works in practice for the deployed environment. Consider omitting the behavior key entirely for maximum compatibility.
seed_data_creation: None. Added one Mozza Sticks (x8) to cart during checkout scroll test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Category chip data-testids are `cat-{slug}` and the header cart link is `cart-icon-link` (NOT `header-cart`). ScrollToTop is mounted in App.js above Routes and works on all client-side route changes. Menu default active category is the first visible category (currently 'signatures'). Wraps has 6 items in preview DB (not 3 as stated in some review docs).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All requested features work as specified.
